retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait featuring a subject in a leather jacket with dramatic side-lighting and large, condensed serif typography spanning the top and bottom edges.
excludeWhen: landscape or nature-focused imagery is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast black and white close-up portrait of a male figure with curly hair wearing a leather jacket. The lighting is harsh, casting deep shadows on one side of the face. Large, light blue or white condensed serif text is positioned at the extreme top and bottom of the frame, overlapping the subject's hair.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's face is the primary focal point, positioned slightly off-center.
The typography acts as a frame, anchoring the top and bottom edges of the composition.
The texture of the leather jacket provides a tactile contrast to the smooth skin tones.
The high-contrast lighting creates a moody, intense atmosphere.
coreInvariants: High-contrast monochrome photography with deep blacks and bright highlights.
Condensed serif typography with high stroke contrast.
Subject wearing a textured leather jacket.
Text overlapping the subject's hair at the top edge.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, subject occupies approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's illuminated eye and the large-scale typography at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down to the subject's face, follows the line of the jacket to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with the subject and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows against bright white highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue or white for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation in the image; high value contrast between text and background.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' has a sharp, vertical spur.
The 'R' has a graceful, curved leg.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent use of the same typeface family in different scales and colors.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant serif structure.
Provides the necessary vertical stress and thin serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with curly hair wearing a black leather jacket, using dramatic side-lighting to create deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, condensed serif text in uppercase at the top and bottom edges. The top text should be a pale blue and slightly overlap the hair; the bottom text should be white.

verificationChecks: Is the typography a condensed modern serif?
Does the top text overlap the subject's hair?

mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific artist names or album titles.
Ensure the leather jacket texture is prominent.
postGenerationChecks: Verify text placement at extreme edges.
Ensure the serif font is condensed and high-contrast.
Confirm the leather jacket texture is visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + leather jacket + condensed modern serif typography at top/bottom edges.
